content: Hello! Could you tell me about a recent machine learning model you deployed to production?
Yes, I recently built a churn prediction model. I used XGBoost for the classification. We had imbalanced data, so I applied SMOTE for oversampling and tuned hyperparameters using Optuna.
How did you measure the performance of this model, considering the imbalanced dataset?

Accuracy wasn't useful due to the class imbalance, so I focused on the PR-AUC (Precision-Recall Area Under Curve). I also looked closely at the F1-score and the recall for the positive class since missing a churning customer was more expensive than a false positive.
